definitions.explanation: The year before this one; the previous year. Used to refer to events or states in the year that just passed.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to Japan last year.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}の{夏|なつ}はとても{暑|あつ}かったです。
{去年|きょねん}から{日本語|にほんご}を{習|なら}っています。
examples.english: I've been learning Japanese since last year.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}の{今|いま}ごろ、{何|なに}をしていましたか。
examples.english: What were you doing around this time last year?

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}は{大|たい}{変|へん}な{一|いち}{年|ねん}でした。{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しもしたし、{新|あたら}しい{仕事|しごと}も{始|はじ}めました。
examples.english: Last year was a tough year. I moved and also started a new job.

notes: Part of a time reference series: {去年|きょねん} (last year), {今年|ことし} (this year), {来年|らいねん} (next year). Can be used with の to modify nouns: {去年|きょねん}の{冬|ふゆ} (last winter). A more formal word for last year is {昨年|さくねん}.
